01-1.author: Gemma Frisius
01-1.caption: Gemma Frisius's 1545 woodcut: a room-sized camera obscura projects the eclipsed Sun of January 1544 onto its wall.

01-2.author: Osama Shukir Muhammed Amin FRCP(Glasg)

02-1.author: Léonard François Berger
02-1.caption: Painted portrait of the French inventor Joseph Nicéphore Niépce by Léonard-François Berger, made after his death.

02-2.author: Unknown authorUnknown author
02-2.caption: Old engraving of an artist using a camera lucida prism on a stand to trace a small statue onto paper.

02-3.author: Thomas Lawrence
02-3.caption: Chemist Humphry Davy painted by Sir Thomas Lawrence, with his miners' safety lamp on the table beside him.

03-1.author: Joseph Nicéphore Niépce
03-1.caption: Niépce's View from the Window at Le Gras (about 1826-27), the oldest surviving camera photograph, in an enhanced 1950s copy.

03-2.author: Héliogravure von Dujardin, nach einem Gemälde von Léonard-François Berger (1845), heute in den Musée Denon in Chalon-sur-Saône.
03-2.caption: Joseph Nicéphore Niépce in a printed portrait by Dujardin, copied from Léonard-François Berger's painting.

03-3.file: Le cardinal d'Amboise. 1er résultat héliographique de N. Niépce. 1824. Zinc gravé - reproduction - btv1b108489114.jpg
03-3.author: Bibliothèque nationale de France
03-3.caption: Old photo of Niépce's framed metal plate copying a portrait of Cardinal d'Amboise, labelled his first heliographic result.

04-1.author: Louis Daguerre
04-1.caption: Daguerre's 1838 Boulevard du Temple: the busy street looks empty, but a man having his boots shined appears at lower left.

04-2.author: Robert Cornelius
04-2.caption: Robert Cornelius's 1839 daguerreotype self-portrait, arms crossed, one of the earliest photographs of a person.

04-3.author: CARLOS TEIXIDOR CADENAS
04-3.caption: An original 1839 Giroux daguerreotype camera, a wooden box with a brass lens and Daguerre's signed label, in Barcelona.

05-1.author: William Henry Fox Talbot
05-1.caption: Talbot's August 1835 paper negative of the latticed window at Lacock Abbey, with his handwritten note beside it.

05-2.author: Anna Atkins
05-2.caption: A blue cyanotype of the seaweed Cystoseira ericoides from Anna Atkins's book Photographs of British Algae.

05-3.author: Hippolyte Bayard
05-3.caption: Photography pioneer Hippolyte Bayard's 1847 self-portrait among flowerpots and tools in a garden, a salt print.
